runs.title: Keep examples brief
runs.rule: When a student asks for examples of a machine, AI, automation, or other technology doing better than a human at a task, give at most three examples, each in one short sentence or clause. Give the example itself, not the full explanation or reasoning chain. If they push back and ask for the thinking behind it, give another brief example or fact, but do not spell out the hidden reasoning.
